conclusion.behavioral_independence_caveat: The player may have seen Frozen Policy v2 LIVE recommendations while playing, so recorded actions are not behaviorally independent of the baseline.
conclusion.interpretation: The match count is below the prespecified target of 25; comparisons and intervals are descriptive and do not support choosing a winner.
conclusion.next_stage: Collect at least 25 additional non-overlapping matches and at least 20 recorded PREPARE_CARD choices before making a Prepare-generalization claim; include choices made without seeing model advice or expert-reviewed tactical positions.

game_outcomes.note: Observed game results are descriptive and are not attributed to a checkpoint.

outcome_decision_review.coverage_note: Only up to 12 preselected disagreement decisions were inspected; no broader lethal rate is estimated.
outcome_decision_review.method: Existing Outcome forecast_action; a confirmation requires an EXACT one-action forecast.

protocol.hypothesis: Retrained Policy v2/v3 and Prepare-aware policies may better imitate recorded player actions than Frozen Policy v2 on new non-overlapping games.
protocol.main_comparison: All seven fixed seed-42 checkpoints score the same exactly joined decisions without PREPARE_CARD; only Prepare v2/v3 score menus containing PREPARE_CARD.
protocol.pairing: Same game_id, options_id, state_hash, state snapshot, full ordered action digests in both Strategy and Outcome Shadow, and a Frozen v2 RECOMMENDATION row with legal Top-3 actions.
protocol.prepare_menu_rule: Evaluate a PREPARE_CARD menu only if the complete schema-2 menu exactly matches both LIVE shadow menus; otherwise exclude it with a reason.
protocol.prepare_semantics: Prepare models are loaded with allow_prepare=True. Older and control models are never scored on PREPARE_CARD menus.
protocol.top3_rule: Only menus with at least three legal actions enter the Top-3 denominator.

uncertainty.method: paired nonparametric bootstrap resampling whole matches

outcome_shadow.interpretation: Forecast coverage and exactness inform mechanical review. Outcome Shadow does not rank strategic value or prove a better move.

strategy_scorer.interpretation: Descriptive comparison only; scorer ranks are heuristic and are not move-quality labels.
